<DESCRIPTION>PROMISSORY NOTE, DATED SEPTEMBER 30, 2026, ISSUED BY MINERALRITE CORPORATION TO ABSTRACT CONCEPTS 1618 LLC.
<TEXT>
<HTML>
<HEAD>
<TITLE></TITLE>
</HEAD>
<BODY>


<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 6pt; text-align: center">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 6pt; text-align: right"><B>Exhibit 10.2</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 6pt; text-align: center"><B>PROMISSORY NOTE</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 6pt; text-align: center"><B>$106,724,942.00</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 6pt; text-align: center"><B>Executed and effective as of September 30,
2026.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 6pt; text-align: center"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B>FOR VALUE RECEIVED</B>, MineralRite Corporation,
a Texas corporation (&ldquo;Maker&rdquo;), promises to pay to the order of Abstract Concepts 1618 LLC (&ldquo;Holder&rdquo;) the principal
sum of ONE HUNDRED SIX MILLION SEVEN HUNDRED TWENTY-FOUR THOUSAND NINE HUNDRED FORTY-TWO DOLLARS ($106,724,942.00), subject to the terms
below.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><B>1. Interest; Maturity.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">This Note bears no interest. This Note is due and
payable on the Closing Date and is intended to be satisfied at Closing principally through the application and setoff described in the
Royalty Repurchase, Warrant Exercise and Note Satisfaction Agreement executed contemporaneously herewith.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><B>2. Payment by Application and Setoff.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">Holder irrevocably authorizes Maker to apply amounts
otherwise payable by Holder to Maker against the outstanding principal of this Note. Such application and setoff shall constitute payment
in the same amount as if cash had been paid by Maker to Holder and immediately returned by Holder to Maker.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><B>3. Complete Satisfaction.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">Maker and Holder acknowledge that the aggregate contractual
applications contemplated at Closing total $106,724,942.00, equal to the face amount of this Note. The Parties agree that completion of
the contemplated applications constitutes full and complete payment and satisfaction of this Note. Upon such completion, the outstanding
balance shall be zero and this Note shall be deemed paid, discharged, surrendered and cancelled.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><B>4. No Assignment Except with Transaction Documents.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">Holder shall not assign this Note separately from
the rights and obligations arising under the contemporaneous transaction documents without Maker&rsquo;s written consent.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><B>5. Governing Law.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">This Note is governed by Texas law. Exclusive venue
shall lie in the state or federal courts located in Dallas County, Texas. Counterpart and electronic signatures are effective as originals.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 6pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;</P>
